newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LEEDS SAY THEY HAVE WON THE RACE FOR SCALES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LEEDS SAY THEY HAVE WON THE RACE FOR SCALES.

text.p: Leeds United insisted on Sunday they have won the race to sign 30-year-old central defender John Scales from Liverpool despite a late bid from Tottenham.
Leeds chairman Bill Fotherby said Scales would be unveiled at a news conference on Monday afternoon, along with another signing who has not been identified.
Leeds are believed to have agreed a fee of three million pounds ($4.92 million) with Liverpool. But Spurs, alerted to the fact he had become available, then moved in.
"Spurs did make a bid for him, but there is no question in my mind that John will be joining us," Fotherby said.
"He is a Leeds boy and this is where he wants to be. He knows this club is moving forward."
Scales had indicated earlier he was looking forward to returning to the club and working with manager George Graham.
He added that he expected to sign on Monday.
